verdict.rationale: OpenClaw exposes several API-style surfaces beyond its Control UI — a Chat Completions HTTP API, a tools-invoke HTTP endpoint, an MCP server mode, and a full CLI — suggesting broad but not explicitly guaranteed parity with the browser Control UI or desktop/mobile apps. However, there is no documented OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s across candidate spec URLs) and no explicit statement that every UI/app action (e.g. node camera/device control, computer-use, standing orders) is reachable via API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, a published OpenAPI/API reference covering all capabilities, and confirmation that Control UI-only features are also API-accessible.
